7735277147.description: White Lacoste low-top sneakers with mesh panels, light grey overlays and white laces. The side shows a green crocodile logo with LACOSTE wordmark, set on a cream midsole with a black lugged outsole.

7735280075.alt_text: Navy Loro Piana zip-up gilet with stand collar, side slit pockets and elasticated hem
7735280075.description: Navy sleeveless gilet from Loro Piana with a stand collar and full-length two-way zip with metal ring pulls. It has vertical slit side pockets and an elasticated hem, shown on a wooden hanger.

7735311016.alt_text: White Kenzo t-shirt with large blue tiger head graphic and navy Kenzo Paris wordmark on the chest
7735311016.description: White short sleeve crewneck t-shirt with a large blue tiger head graphic across the chest. A navy Kenzo wordmark sits over the tiger with Paris lettering below, and a Kenzo label shows inside the neck.

7735314976.alt_text: Navy Stone Island polo shirt with white tipped collar and cuffs and compass badge on the left sleeve
7735314976.description: Navy Stone Island short sleeve polo shirt with a two-button placket and white double-stripe tipping on the collar and sleeve cuffs. A compass badge sits on the left sleeve, with a hanging tag and branded neck label visible.

7735329313.alt_text: Black Amiri crewneck sweatshirt with white AMIRI wordmark and white cracked line print rising from the hem
7735329313.description: Black Amiri crewneck sweatshirt with a large white AMIRI wordmark across the chest and a white cracked, vein-like print spreading up from the hem and sleeves. It has ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, with a small brand label inside the neck.

7735363614.alt_text: Black Chrome Hearts umbrella with white cross emblem and gothic script wordmark printed around the edge
7735363614.description: Black open umbrella with a white Chrome Hearts cross emblem printed on one panel. Gothic script text including the Chrome Hearts wordmark runs around the lower edge of the canopy.

7735429828.alt_text: Brown Supreme hoodie in tree camo print with red box logo on the chest
7735429828.description: Brown tree camo pullover hoodie with a red Supreme box logo across the chest and a red label inside the hood. It has a drawstring hood, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem.

7735435828.alt_text: Grey Goyard crossbody camera bag with all-over chevron monogram print and adjustable grey strap
7735435828.description: Grey Goyard crossbody bag in a rectangular camera shape with an all-over Y chevron monogram print, a top zip and a front slip pocket. It has grey trim with contrast stitching and an adjustable grey strap with a silver-tone buckle.

7735446233.alt_text: Black Prada shorts with drawstring waist, silver zip pockets and triangle logo plaque on the right leg
7735446233.description: Black Prada shorts with an elastic ribbed waistband, black drawstring with silver tips and two diagonal silver zip pockets. A small black and silver triangle logo plaque sits on the right front leg.

7735448427.alt_text: Light grey Stone Island hoodie and sweatpants set with compass badge patches on sleeve and leg
7735448427.description: Light heather grey hoodie with kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs, shown with matching sweatpants with elastic waist and cuffed ankles. Both pieces carry the Stone Island compass badge patch, on the left sleeve and the upper leg.

7735467957.alt_text: Black Amiri faded shorts with cream waistband and large arched AMIRI letter logo across the legs
7735467957.description: Faded black Amiri shorts shown front and back, with a contrast cream elastic waistband, white drawcord and raw cut hems. A large arched AMIRI letter appliqué wraps around the legs, and the back has a patch pocket and a small label at the waistband.

7735499867.alt_text: Black Travis Scott hoodie with white Cactus Jack cross logo on the chest and Travis Scott text on both sleeves
7735499867.description: Black pullover hoodie with drawstring hood and front kangaroo pocket. White hand-drawn Cactus Jack cross logo sits on the chest, with Travis Scott lettering printed down both sleeves.

7735602845.alt_text: Black Amiri crewneck sweatshirt with large white wordmark and multicoloured paint drip print
7735602845.description: Black crewneck sweatshirt shown from the back with a large white AMIRI wordmark and multicoloured paint drip lines running down. It has dropped shoulders, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a small metal tag near the lower right hem.

7735925430.alt_text: Red Adidas Gazelle sneakers with white three stripes, gold Gazelle lettering and gum soles
7735925430.description: A pair of red suede Adidas Gazelle sneakers with white three stripes, white heel tabs and gold Gazelle lettering on the side. They have red laces, blue trefoil tongue labels and brown gum rubber soles with embossed Adidas branding.

7735934192.alt_text: Black Ralph Lauren polo shirt with small red embroidered pony logo on the chest
7735934192.description: Black short sleeve Ralph Lauren polo shirt with a ribbed collar and two-button placket. A small red pony logo is embroidered on the left chest and a blue Polo label sits inside the neck.

7736001819.alt_text: White Hermes t-shirt with small black H logo on the left chest
7736001819.description: White short sleeve Hermes t-shirt with a ribbed crew neck and a small black H logo on the left chest. It has dropped shoulders, a boxy cut and a brand neck label with an attached hang tag.

7736006200.alt_text: White Jordan track joggers with red and black side stripes, repeated JORDAN tape and red Jumpman logo
7736006200.description: White Jordan track joggers with an elastic drawstring waist, ribbed cuffs and a small red Jumpman logo on the left thigh. Red and black side stripes run beside a white tape printed with a repeated black JORDAN wordmark.

7736101942.alt_text: Black and yellow Louis Vuitton varsity jacket with chenille L and V patches on the chest and patched sleeves
7736101942.description: Black varsity jacket with yellow sleeves, striped rib collar, cuffs and hem, snap front and welt pockets trimmed in yellow. Chenille L and V patches sit on the chest with a flower patch below and graffiti-style patches on both sleeves.

7736363133.alt_text: Black Nike crewneck sweatshirt with white chest logo and large NIKE wordmark down the sleeve
7736363133.description: Black Nike crewneck sweatshirt with a small white NIKE wordmark and swoosh on the chest. The right sleeve has a large vertical NIKE wordmark, the left sleeve a white swoosh, with ribbed cuffs and hem.

773708784961.alt_text: Blue Saint Laurent washed denim jeans folded to show back pocket and brown leather patch with metal YSL logo
773708784961.description: Folded blue washed denim jeans with a back patch pocket, light distressing and contrast stitching. A brown leather waistband patch carries a metal YSL monogram and Saint Laurent wordmark.

7737128603.alt_text: Silver Cartier Juste un Clou bangle bracelet shaped like a bent nail with a flat head and pointed tip
7737128603.description: Silver Cartier Juste un Clou bracelet in a polished finish, shaped like a nail curved into a bangle. The flat nail head overlaps the pointed tip and a hinge is visible on the band.

7737231238.alt_text: Light blue Saint Laurent jeans with navy embroidered YSL logo on the back pocket and black leather waist patch
7737231238.description: Folded light blue grey washed denim jeans showing the back pocket with a large navy embroidered YSL monogram logo. A black leather patch with an embossed YSL logo sits on the rear waistband.

7737310484.alt_text: Navy Fred Perry track jacket with white zip, funnel collar and white logo taping down both sleeves
7737310484.description: Navy track jacket with a funnel collar, contrast white full-length zip and two side welt pockets. A small white emblem sits on the left chest and white taping with repeated navy motifs runs down each sleeve.

7737440146.alt_text: White The North Face bomber jacket with black chest logo, ribbed collar and two zip patch pockets
7737440146.description: White bomber jacket with a ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, a black full-length front zip and two patch pockets with diagonal zips. A small black The North Face logo is embroidered on the left chest.

7737492460.alt_text: Black Ralph Lauren leather jacket with point collar, brass zip and small tonal pony logo on the chest
7737492460.description: Black Ralph Lauren leather jacket with a point collar, full-length brass-tone zip and two slanted hand pockets. A small tonal pony logo sits on the chest and a blue Polo Ralph Lauren tag hangs from the collar.

7737606006.alt_text: Black Amiri crewneck sweatshirt with large floral AMIRI wordmark across the chest
7737606006.description: Black Amiri crewneck sweatshirt with a large AMIRI wordmark across the chest, decorated with pink flowers and leaves. It has ribbed cuffs and hem and a black neck label.

7737772584.alt_text: Black Vans low-top sneakers with white laces, side stripe and black rubber sole on a reflective surface
7737772584.description: Pair of black Vans low-top sneakers with suede toe and heel panels, white contrast stitching, white laces and a black side stripe. A small checkerboard label sits on the side above a black rubber sole.

7738121301.alt_text: Black Asics hooded windbreaker with white logo on the chest and full front zip
7738121301.description: Black Asics windbreaker with a drawstring hood, full-length front zip and white logo on the left chest. It has elasticated cuffs, zipped side pockets and a purple brand tag attached at the collar.

7738277100.alt_text: Navy Lacoste crewneck sweatshirt with white chest stripes, light blue sleeve panels and small crocodile logo
7738277100.description: Navy Lacoste crewneck sweatshirt with two thin white horizontal stripes across the chest and light blue colour-block panels on the upper sleeves. A small green crocodile logo sits on the left chest, with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem.

7738380602.alt_text: Black Nike NOCTA shorts with yellow swoosh logo, drawstring waist and zip side pocket
7738380602.description: Black Nike shorts with an elastic drawstring waistband and a vertical zip pocket on the right leg. A small yellow swoosh sits on the left leg and a yellow NOCTA wordmark is printed near the right hem.

7738426312.alt_text: Black Vlone hoodie with large white and purple VLONE logo on the front and flame prints on the sleeves
7738426312.description: Black pullover hoodie with a large white VLONE wordmark and purple V across the front. One sleeve has a white flame print and the other a purple flame print, shown on a hanger.

7738428372.alt_text: Black Ralph Lauren textured shirt and drawstring trousers set with small white pony logos
7738428372.description: Black two-piece set with a band collar button-front shirt with rolled sleeves and matching drawstring trousers with side pockets. Both pieces have a ribbed texture and a small white embroidered pony logo on the chest and hip.

7738446060.alt_text: Grey Bape polo shirt with small brown ape head logo on the chest
7738446060.description: Grey short sleeve polo shirt with a ribbed collar and two-button placket. A small brown ape head logo sits on the left chest, with a Bape neck label inside.

7738448449.alt_text: Black Kenzo t-shirt with large purple and blue tiger head and KENZO PARIS wordmark on the front
7738448449.description: Black short sleeve crew neck t-shirt with a large purple and blue tiger head graphic on the chest. The KENZO PARIS wordmark sits across the tiger, with a Kenzo neck label and a green hang tag attached.

7738692613.alt_text: Black Represent shorts with drawstring waist and white wordmark logo on the lower left leg
7738692613.description: Black Represent shorts with an elasticated drawstring waistband, side pockets and split curved hems. A white Represent wordmark with script text sits on the lower left leg.

7738696545.alt_text: Black Chrome Hearts jeans with white, yellow, blue and orange cross patches and white paint splatter
7738696545.description: Washed black denim jeans with a five-pocket layout, button fly and straight legs. The front is covered in white, yellow, blue and orange Chrome Hearts cross patches with white paint splatter.

7738809988.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren harrington-style bomber jacket with small red pony logo on the chest
7738809988.description: Navy Ralph Lauren bomber jacket with a stand collar, buttoned throat tab, full front zip and two flap pockets with buttons. A small red pony logo sits on the chest, with ribbed cuffs and hem and a check lining visible at the collar.

7738886130.alt_text: Black Adidas long sleeve polo shirt with three-button placket and grey logo on the chest
7738886130.description: Black long sleeve polo shirt from Adidas with a pointed collar and three-button placket. A small grey Adidas logo and wordmark sits on the left chest, shown on a mannequin with patterned shorts.

7739061626.alt_text: Grey and black Salomon sneakers with white midsole and quick lace system worn with grey trousers
7739061626.description: The photo shows a pair of Salomon sneakers in grey and black with white and grey midsoles, a quick lace closure and layered side overlays. They are worn by a model in grey trousers and a black t-shirt, so the shoes appear small in the frame.

7739337556.alt_text: Black Off-White knit crewneck sweater with large cream Off- logo on the chest
7739337556.description: Black crewneck knit sweater with a large cream Off- wordmark knitted across the upper right chest. It has ribbed cuffs and hem and an Off-White label at the inside collar.

7739353220.alt_text: Navy Stone Island knit sweater with white outlined DIOR and compass logo on the back and striped cuffs
7739353220.description: Navy knit sweater shown from the back with a white outlined DIOR wordmark incorporating the Stone Island compass badge. Long sleeves finish with two white stripes near the ribbed cuffs.

7739373304.alt_text: Red and navy striped Corteiz football jersey with white wordmark across the chest and crest badge
7739373304.description: Red and navy hooped Corteiz football jersey with a red collar and short sleeves. It has a large white Corteiz wordmark on the chest, a monogram crest with three stars on the left and an oval logo patch on the right.

773942136402.alt_text: Black Corteiz pullover hoodie with large white oval Alcatraz logo print on the chest
773942136402.description: Black Corteiz pullover hoodie with a large white oval Alcatraz island logo printed across the chest. It has a lined hood, a front kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem.

7739455786.alt_text: Black Moncler turtleneck sweater with large white logo character print with arms and red trainers on the front
7739455786.description: Black Moncler turtleneck sweater with ribbed roll neck, cuffs and hem. The front shows a large white Moncler logo drawn as a running character with fists and red and white trainers.

7739544255.alt_text: Yellow Chrome Hearts jeans with white cross patches down one leg and a large cross patch on the other knee
7739544255.description: Yellow five-pocket Chrome Hearts jeans with a button fly waist, belt loops and a straight leg. A column of small white cross patches runs down the right leg and a large outlined cross patch sits on the left knee.

7739581689.alt_text: Blue Jordan 4 denim sneakers with navy laces, tan Jumpman tongue patches and cream gum sole
7739581689.description: Pair of blue denim Air Jordan 4 sneakers with navy laces, olive mesh panels and tan Jumpman patches on the tongues. A hanging Jumpman tag, small red tab on the side and cream midsole with gum outsole are visible.

7739786803.alt_text: Silver Lacoste link bracelet with engraved crocodile logo on the clasp and textured petit pique links
7739786803.description: Silver metal link bracelet from Lacoste with alternating plain and textured cross-hatch links. The fold-over clasp at the centre carries an engraved crocodile logo.

7740142539.alt_text: Grey Adidas camo track pants with white side stripes, trefoil logo and ape head logo on the front
7740142539.description: Grey and black camo track pants with an elasticated waist, white three-stripe side tape and a wide leg with knee pleats. A white Adidas trefoil logo and an ape head logo sit at the upper front, with small logos within the camo print.

7740196474.alt_text: White Burberry polo shirt with embroidered equestrian knight logo and wordmark on the chest
7740196474.description: White short sleeve polo shirt with a ribbed collar and three-button placket, shown on a dark mannequin. A multicoloured Burberry equestrian knight emblem with black wordmark is embroidered on the left chest.

7740203339.alt_text: Brown Experiment Five leather card holder with embossed brick wall pattern and script logo
7740203339.description: Brown leather card holder with several stacked card slots, a curved top edge on the front pocket and contrast stitching around the edges. The front shows an embossed brick wall design with the Experiment Five script logo debossed above it.

7740727214.alt_text: Black Off-White hoodie with small OFF wordmark and arrows logo printed on the chest
7740727214.description: Black pullover hoodie with drawstring hood, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem. Small OFF wordmark on the right chest and the Off-White arrows logo with text below on the left chest, both in a multicoloured print.

7740824727.alt_text: White Supreme tracksuit with half zip top, grey piping, embroidered wordmark and red square logo patches
7740824727.description: White Supreme tracksuit with a half zip pullover top and matching track pants, both with curved grey piping. The top has a chest wordmark, a blue crest badge and a red sleeve patch, while the pants have a vertical wordmark and a red logo patch.

7741209472.alt_text: Black Palm Angels baseball cap with white gothic script logo embroidered across the front
7741209472.description: Black six-panel baseball cap with a curved brim, top button and stitched eyelets. White Palm Angels gothic script wordmark is embroidered across the front panels.

7741721423.alt_text: Olive quilted zip vest with diamond stitching, stand collar and Barbour label at the neck
7741721423.description: Olive green diamond-quilted vest with a full front zip, ribbed stand collar and two patch pockets at the hem. The neck label shows Barbour branding with a check lining visible, although the listing names Burberry.

7741730034.alt_text: Black Supreme sweatpants with large vertical white Supreme wordmark down the left leg
7741730034.description: Black Supreme sweatpants with an elasticated waistband and ribbed cuffed ankles. A large white Supreme wordmark runs vertically down the left leg.

774215130015.alt_text: Grey Broken Planet straight leg jeans with white embroidered star outlines and Broken wordmark by front pocket
774215130015.description: Front and back views of grey washed denim jeans in a straight leg cut with five-pocket styling and button fly area. White outlined star embroidery appears on the legs and back pocket, with a Broken wordmark below the front left pocket.

7742593766.alt_text: Red Jordan 4 sneakers with tonal suede upper, mesh side panels and small white swoosh on the toe
7742593766.description: A pair of red Air Jordan 4 sneakers with a tonal nubuck-style upper, mesh side panels, lace wings and matching red laces. A visible air unit with white midsole detail sits at the heel, with a small white swoosh near the toe and Jumpman branding on the tongue.

7742661522.alt_text: Washed black Balmain biker jeans with silver zip pockets and ribbed knee panels
7742661522.description: Washed black denim biker jeans with a faded grey finish, silver zip pockets at the front and hip, and seamed panels at the knees. The slim leg runs straight to the hem, and the listing names Balmain as the brand.

7742812747.alt_text: Black Carhartt hoodie with white wordmark down the sleeve and square logo patch on the kangaroo pocket
7742812747.description: Black Carhartt pullover hoodie with a drawstring hood, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem. A white Carhartt wordmark runs down the left sleeve and a small square logo patch sits on the pocket.

7742846861.alt_text: White Maison Margiela t-shirt with grey handprint graphic and black numbers logo with circled 6 on the front
7742846861.description: White crew neck t-shirt with a large grey handprint graphic across the front. A black numbers grid with a circled 6 logo sits over the print, with a numbered label at the neck.

7742848701.alt_text: Light grey Essentials t-shirt and shorts set with red Fear of God varsity lettering and red 26 on the leg
7742848701.description: Light grey short sleeve t-shirt with ribbed crew neck and red arched Essentials 2026 Fear of God lettering on the chest. Matching shorts have an elastic drawstring waist, a small rubber logo patch and a red 26 print on the left leg.

7742850665.alt_text: Navy Gucci tie with all-over light blue GG monogram and dotted diamond lattice, shown rolled
7742850665.description: Navy tie with an all-over light blue interlocking GG monogram set within a dotted diamond lattice on a textured woven surface. The tie is shown partly rolled with a pointed blade tip.

7742852703.alt_text: Black Gucci tie with tonal grey interlocking GG monogram pattern, partly rolled
7742852703.description: A black Gucci tie shown partly rolled, with an all-over tonal grey interlocking GG monogram linked by small dots. The fabric has a slight sheen and the blade has a pointed tip.

7742856623.alt_text: Navy Louis Vuitton tie with all-over light blue LV monogram flowers and initials, shown rolled
7742856623.description: Navy Louis Vuitton tie shown partly rolled, with a pointed tip. An all-over monogram of LV initials, quatrefoil flowers and circle motifs is woven in light blue and white.

7742858601.alt_text: Burgundy Gucci tie with all-over white GG monogram in a black hexagon lattice, rolled at the end
7742858601.description: Burgundy Gucci tie with a sheen finish, shown partly rolled with a pointed tip. An all-over pattern of white interlocking GG logos sits within a dark hexagonal lattice.

7742864567.alt_text: Red Nike balaclava with white NOCTA wordmark on the side and white dot gradient print across the face panel
7742864567.description: Red balaclava worn by a model, with a white NOCTA wordmark on the side of the head and a small white logo on the crown. The face panel has a white dot gradient print and the hood extends down into a neck covering.

7742872489.alt_text: Grey Corteiz t-shirt with front graphic of stacked folded shirts showing Corteiz and CRTZ wordmarks
7742872489.description: Heather grey crewneck Corteiz t-shirt with short sleeves and a central graphic of stacked folded garments in blue, yellow, red, white and black. Each layer shows a Corteiz, CRTZ or Alcatraz logo, with a small branded label at the neck.

7742872937.alt_text: Light blue Nike NOCTA sweatpants with black drawcord, zip pocket and small white swoosh on the hip
7742872937.description: Light blue Nike NOCTA sweatpants with an elastic waist, black drawcord, side pockets and a zipped pocket on the left leg. A small white swoosh sits on the right hip and a NOCTA wordmark runs down the left leg, with straight-cut legs.

7742876381.alt_text: Light heather grey Essentials t-shirt and shorts set with black Fear of God chest and leg logos
7742876381.description: Light heather grey Essentials set with a dropped-shoulder crewneck t-shirt and matching drawstring shorts. Black Essentials Fear of God wordmarks sit on the chest and left leg, with a rubber logo tab at the shorts waistband.

7742882427.alt_text: Burgundy Louis Vuitton tie with a pointed blade laid in an orange box
7742882427.description: A burgundy Louis Vuitton tie with a solid finish and pointed blade, shown folded inside an open orange box. The listing title describes it as a silk tie, and no logo is visible in the photo.

7742888345.alt_text: Black Gucci tie with all-over grey and silver interlocking GG monogram pattern, shown rolled
7742888345.description: A black tie with an all-over woven pattern of grey and silver interlocking GG logos and small motifs. The tie is shown partly rolled, displaying the pointed blade end.

7742892343.alt_text: Navy Gucci tie with all-over red and white interlocking GG monogram pattern
7742892343.description: A navy tie shown rolled, covered in an all-over interlocking GG monogram woven in red with scattered white GG motifs. The fabric has a fine diagonal twill texture and a pointed tip.

7742892351.alt_text: Navy Louis Vuitton tie with diagonal blue and white stripes and small LV monogram motifs
7742892351.description: Navy tie with diagonal stripes in blue, light blue and white, shown rolled with the pointed tip forward. Small LV initials and monogram flower motifs are spaced between the stripes.

7742896331.alt_text: Black Calvin Klein swim shorts with orange drawcord and orange CK logo on the lower left leg
7742896331.description: Black Calvin Klein swim shorts with an elasticated waist, orange drawcord and side pockets with orange accents. An orange embroidered CK Calvin Klein logo sits on the lower leg, with an orange logo-print lining and mesh inner visible.

7742898365.alt_text: Orange Hermes tie with small light blue, red and gold card suit motifs on a dark ground
7742898365.description: Folded Hermes tie with a repeating pattern of small card suit shapes in orange, red, gold and light blue on a dark base. The woven motifs run in diagonal rows across the blade with no visible logo.

7742904345.alt_text: Olive Corteiz t-shirt with large black Alcatraz logo and four stars printed on the chest
7742904345.description: Olive green short sleeve t-shirt with a crew neck and a yellow neck label. The front has a large black Corteiz Alcatraz oval logo topped by four black stars.

7742912257.alt_text: White Corteiz t-shirt with large black oval Alcatraz logo printed across the chest
7742912257.description: White short sleeve Corteiz t-shirt with a crew neck. A large black oval Alcatraz island logo is printed across the chest.

7742922203.alt_text: White Corteiz sleeveless top with yellow script logo and graphic of a suited figure with two tigers
7742922203.description: White sleeveless Corteiz top with a crew neck and a small woven label inside the collar. The front shows a large yellow Corteiz script wordmark above an illustration of a masked man in a black suit flanked by two yellow tigers.

7742922205.alt_text: Light blue Acne Studios wide leg jeans with tan dirt-effect wash on the front thighs, shown front and back
7742922205.description: Light blue washed denim jeans shown from the front and back, with a tan dirt-effect wash across the front thighs and back pockets. Acne Studios piece with a wide leg cut, five-pocket layout, button fly and a pink leather-look patch at the back waistband.

7742930077.alt_text: Navy and blue Louis Vuitton tie with all-over tonal LV monogram and flower motifs, shown rolled
7742930077.description: Navy Louis Vuitton tie with an all-over woven monogram of LV initials and flower motifs in brighter blue. The tie is shown partly rolled with a pointed blade end.

7742934057.alt_text: Cream Corteiz t-shirt with large pink and white script logo across the chest
7742934057.description: Cream short sleeve t-shirt with a ribbed crew neck and a large pink script Corteiz wordmark with white outline across the chest. A small yellow logo label is visible inside the neckline.

7742936083.alt_text: Black Calvin Klein swim shorts with large white CK monogram and red wordmark on the left leg
7742936083.description: Black Calvin Klein shorts with an elasticated waistband and white drawcord. A large white CK logo with a red Calvin Klein wordmark is printed on the lower left leg.

7742941989.alt_text: Navy Calvin Klein swim shorts with large white vertical CALVIN wordmark down the left leg
7742941989.description: Navy Calvin Klein swim shorts with an elasticated waistband and white drawcord with metal tips. A large white CALVIN wordmark runs vertically down the left leg.

7742943949.alt_text: White Essentials t-shirt and shorts set with grey Essentials Fear of God wordmark on chest and leg
7742943949.description: White Essentials set made up of a short sleeve crew neck t-shirt and drawstring shorts. Both pieces show a grey Essentials Fear of God wordmark, with a small rubber logo tab on the shorts waistband.

7742945963.alt_text: Washed black Acne Studios wide leg jeans with faded thighs shown from front and back
7742945963.description: Washed black denim jeans from Acne Studios with faded whiskering on the thighs and a wide straight leg, shown from front and back. Details include a button fly, five-pocket layout and a dark patch on the back waistband.

7742953907.alt_text: Pink Corteiz zip hoodie and matching sweatpants with white Alcatraz logo on chest and thigh
7742953907.description: Pink Corteiz tracksuit made up of a full zip hoodie with kangaroo pocket and matching sweatpants with elastic waistband and side pockets. Both pieces carry a white oval Alcatraz logo, on the chest and upper thigh.

7742953909.alt_text: Brown Louis Vuitton tie with tonal all-over monogram pattern, shown rolled
7742953909.description: Brown tie with a tonal all-over Louis Vuitton monogram of LV initials and flower motifs woven into a diagonal twill texture. It is shown partly rolled with the pointed blade end at the front.

7742955901.alt_text: Grey and black check Louis Vuitton tie with white flower motifs and LV logo near the tip
7742955901.description: Grey and black check tie with small white four-petal flower motifs scattered across the blade. A white LV logo sits near the pointed tip, shown rolled up.

7742961835.alt_text: Black Valentino belt with red reverse side and gold-tone VLogo buckle held by a white-gloved hand
7742961835.description: Black belt with a red underside and a large gold-tone VLogo buckle, shown held in a white-gloved hand. A red Valentino box with a gold logo sits behind it.

7742961841.alt_text: Grey Louis Vuitton tie with woven black check pattern and tonal LV logo, shown rolled
7742961841.description: Grey and black woven tie with a small check pattern and a tonal LV logo near the centre of the blade. The tie is shown partly rolled with a pointed tip, listed as silk.

7742965791.alt_text: Blue Hermes tie with an all-over light blue H monogram pattern, shown rolled at the top
7742965791.description: A blue Hermes tie with a pointed tip and an all-over light blue H monogram pattern. The tie is shown partly rolled, with the repeating print visible across the blade.

7742971735.alt_text: Red Supreme fleece balaclava with large white Supreme wordmark running vertically down the front
7742971735.description: Red balaclava with a single eye opening and an extended neck section in a soft brushed fabric. A large white Supreme wordmark is printed vertically down the front from below the opening to the hem.

7742971743.alt_text: Light blue Louis Vuitton tie with damier check texture, navy diagonal stripes and small LV crest
7742971743.description: Light blue Louis Vuitton tie shown rolled, with a tonal damier check texture and thin navy diagonal stripes. A small navy LV crest emblem sits near the front blade.

7742971745.alt_text: Blue Hermes tie with all-over white H motif pattern, shown rolled
7742971745.description: Blue Hermes tie shown rolled up, with a repeating white and light grey H motif across the whole blade. The listing title describes it as a silk tie.

7743165488.alt_text: Grey and black Fyredwrld snakeskin-effect belt with gold-tone buckle and matching keeper loop
7743165488.description: Grey, white and black reptile-print belt coiled to show a black reverse side and a gold-tone angular pin buckle. A matching printed keeper loop sits beside the buckle, and the title lists it as a black croc leather belt.

7743172636.alt_text: Black Denim Tears shorts with white drawstring and white African Diaspora Goods logo on the left leg
7743172636.description: Black Denim Tears shorts with an elasticated waistband, long white drawstrings and raw-cut hems. A white African Diaspora Goods Denim Tears logo with a cotton flower emblem is printed on the upper left leg.

7743268688.alt_text: Black Supreme Umbro shorts with large white Supreme wordmark, white side stripes and red crest badge
7743268688.description: Black Supreme x Umbro shorts with an elastic waistband, a large white Supreme wordmark across the front and white piping down each side. A red shield crest sits on the left leg and a white Umbro logo on the right leg.

7743545986.alt_text: Black Ralph Lauren pullover hoodie with cream drawstrings, kangaroo pocket and small round chest emblem
7743545986.description: Black pullover hoodie with a lined hood, cream drawstrings with metal tips and a front kangaroo pocket. A small dark round emblem sits on the left chest, with ribbed cuffs and hem.

7743614459.alt_text: Black Trapstar zip hoodie and jogger tracksuit with multicoloured arched wordmark lettering
7743614459.description: Black Trapstar tracksuit made up of a full zip hoodie with side pockets and matching drawstring joggers. Both pieces carry a large multicoloured patchwork Trapstar wordmark, across the chest and on the upper thigh.

7743636037.alt_text: Black Adidas Terrex mid hiking boots with light blue three stripes, grey mesh panels and lugged grey sole
7743636037.description: Black Adidas Terrex Swift mid-height hiking boot with grey mesh side panels, light blue three stripes and a Gore-Tex tag. It has a padded collar with heel pull loop, black lace hooks and a chunky lugged sole with grey tread.

7743676037.alt_text: Tan Supreme ribbed knit beanie with red box logo patch on the cuff and vertical red logo tag on the crown
7743676037.description: Tan ribbed knit beanie with a folded cuff and a red Supreme box logo patch on the front of the cuff. A vertical red tag with the white Supreme wordmark is attached above the cuff.

7743862717.alt_text: Black Supreme lace-up work boot with tonal debossed pattern and small red box logo tab on the side
7743862717.description: Black lace-up work boot with a tonal debossed pattern, padded collar, silver-tone eyelets and speed hooks, and a chunky lug sole. A small red Supreme box logo tab sits on the outer side near the collar.

7743889503.alt_text: Cream Moncler sweatpants with drawstring waist, small logo patch at the upper thigh and ribbed cuffs
7743889503.description: Cream heather Moncler sweatpants with an elastic drawstring waistband, side pockets and ribbed ankle cuffs. A small round Moncler logo patch sits at the upper left thigh.

7743906437.alt_text: Black Fendi crewneck sweatshirt with large grey FENDI wordmark outlined in yellow across the chest
7743906437.description: Black crewneck sweatshirt with a large grey FENDI wordmark outlined in yellow across the chest. It has ribbed cuffs and hem and a small brand label inside the neckline.

7743907411.alt_text: Grey Louis Vuitton puffer jacket with embossed LV monogram and flower motifs across quilted panels
7743907411.description: Grey quilted puffer jacket with embossed LV monogram and flower motifs, a high stand collar and a full front zip. It has side slip pockets, elasticated cuffs and a Louis Vuitton hang tag.

7743914375.alt_text: Grey On Running tracksuit with hooded zip jacket and cuffed track pants with white logos
7743914375.description: Grey tracksuit with a hooded full-zip jacket featuring a white On logo on the chest, ON RUNNING text and zip pockets. Matching cuffed track pants have a white On logo at the hip and vertical ON RUNNING text on the leg.

7743954927.alt_text: Grey Ralph Lauren crewneck sweatshirt with Polo Bear tennis graphic on the chest
7743954927.description: Heather grey crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem and a navy Polo Ralph Lauren neck label. The front shows a Polo Bear in white tennis clothes holding a racket, with POLO BEAR by RALPH LAUREN text and a signature below.

7743959717.alt_text: Beige Lacoste mock neck sweater with small green crocodile logo on the chest
7743959717.description: Beige Lacoste knit sweater with a mock neck and a small green crocodile logo on the left chest. It has long sleeves with ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem.

7743974839.alt_text: Black Carhartt puffer jackets with square logo patch on the chest, shown in two versions side by side
7743974839.description: Two black Carhartt puffer jackets with quilted panels, stand collars, full front zips and elastic cuffs. One has an orange square logo patch and the other a white and red logo patch on the chest, both with hang tags attached.

7744013033.alt_text: White Amiri shorts with black wordmark and rainbow paint drip graphic on the left leg
7744013033.description: White Amiri shorts with an elastic waistband and white drawstring with metal tips. The lower left leg shows a black AMIRI wordmark above a rainbow paint drip graphic.

7744031299.alt_text: Black Jordan backpack with tonal Jumpman logo on the front pocket and white lettering on the top strap
7744031299.description: Black Jordan backpack with a smooth finish, a large front zip pocket and a tonal Jumpman logo near the base. The top carry handle shows white lettering and the main compartment has twin black zip pullers.

7744041627.alt_text: Blue Lacoste crewneck t-shirt with small green crocodile logo on the chest
7744041627.description: Blue Lacoste short sleeve t-shirt with a ribbed crew neck and dropped shoulders. A small green crocodile logo sits on the left chest and a white brand label is inside the neck.

7744059725.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren shorts with white drawstring waist and small white pony logo on the left leg
7744059725.description: Navy Ralph Lauren shorts with an elasticated waistband, white drawstring cords and a button fly opening. A small white embroidered pony logo sits on the lower left leg.

7744067801.alt_text: White crewneck sweatshirt with black hexagon Gucci logo and Seoul Gyeongbokgung Palace text on the chest
7744067801.description: White crewneck top shown flat with a large black hexagonal Gucci emblem framed by Gyeongbokgung text on the front. Below the emblem reads Seoul Gyeongbokgung Palace, and a beige Gucci label sits inside the neck.

7744100507.alt_text: Black Adidas shorts with long drawstring waist and blue trefoil logo on the lower left leg
7744100507.description: Black Adidas shorts with an elasticated waist, belt loops and a long black drawstring with blue tips. Side slant pockets, a utility loop on the right leg and a blue trefoil logo near the left hem.

7744136555.alt_text: Grey Moncler ribbed knit beanie with folded cuff and white logo patch on the front
7744136555.description: Grey ribbed knit beanie with a wide turned-up cuff. A white Moncler logo patch with navy and red detailing sits on the front of the cuff.

7744294605.alt_text: Cream Fear of God hooded sherpa fleece vest with full zip and two patch pockets
7744294605.description: Cream sherpa fleece vest with an attached hood, smooth beige lining and a black label at the neck. It has a full-length silver-tone zip and two patch pockets with trimmed edges at the front.

7744580172.alt_text: Black Chrome Hearts shorts with tonal cross print, white horseshoe logo and gothic wordmark down the legs
7744580172.description: Black drawstring shorts with an elastic waist, side pockets and an all-over tonal cross print, plus a dark CH logo at the front. A white horseshoe logo sits on the left hip and white gothic Chrome Hearts lettering runs down each leg.

7745072057.alt_text: Grey and black Louis Vuitton monogram crossbody bag with detachable pouch and black logo webbing strap
7745072057.description: Grey and black Louis Vuitton crossbody bag with an all-over LV monogram, a zip top, a front zip pocket and silver-tone hardware. It comes with a small detachable zip pouch and a wide black strap with a woven wordmark.

7745131705.alt_text: Light blue Saint Laurent washed jeans with dark YSL logo embroidered on the back pocket
7745131705.description: Light wash blue denim jeans shown from the back with faded whiskering, two back pockets and belt loops. A dark YSL monogram is embroidered on the right back pocket and black brand tags hang from the waistband.

7745533285.alt_text: Black Ralph Lauren long sleeve button-up shirt with small white pony logo on the chest
7745533285.description: Black long sleeve button-up shirt with a point collar, white buttons and buttoned cuffs. A small white Ralph Lauren pony logo sits on the left chest and a navy Polo label is inside the collar.

7745805979.alt_text: White and blue Burberry long sleeve button-up shirt with large diagonal check pattern on a hanger
7745805979.description: White long sleeve button-up shirt with a large blue diagonal check pattern, point collar and buttoned cuffs. It hangs on a Burberry branded wooden hanger with a Burberry tag attached at the front.

7745836862.alt_text: Grey Hermes tie with all-over woven H pattern, shown rolled up
7745836862.description: Grey Hermes tie shown partly rolled, with a pointed blade tip. The surface carries an all-over woven H pattern in a lighter grey tone, and the title lists it as silk.

7745852536.alt_text: Cream Ami t-shirt with red square Ami Paris script patch on the front and small heart logo on the back
7745852536.description: Cream short sleeve crew neck t-shirt from Ami shown from front and back. The front has a square patch with red Ami Paris script and a red border, and the back has a small dark heart logo below the collar.

7745862494.alt_text: Light blue and navy Gucci tie with all-over interlocking letter monogram pattern, shown rolled
7745862494.description: Light blue tie with an all-over interlocking letter monogram woven on a dark navy ground. The tie is shown partly rolled with a pointed blade end.

7745866382.alt_text: Navy and red Gucci tie with all-over GG monogram and small yellow bee motifs, shown rolled
7745866382.description: Navy tie with an all-over red interlocking GG monogram and scattered small yellow bee motifs. The tie is shown partly rolled with a pointed tip at the front.

7745866386.alt_text: Navy Hermes tie with scattered light blue horseshoe and small horse print, shown rolled
7745866386.description: Navy Hermes tie shown partly rolled, with a pointed tip and an all-over print of small light blue horseshoes and white horse motifs. The listing title describes it as a silk tie with a navy print.

7745870430.alt_text: Blue Hermes tie with all-over white H monogram pattern, shown rolled
7745870430.description: Blue Hermes tie rolled up to show the pointed blade and fine twill texture. An all-over pattern of small white H letters covers the surface, and the title lists it as silk.

7745872422.alt_text: White Calvin Klein shorts with black CK logo side tape and white drawstring waist
7745872422.description: White Calvin Klein shorts with an elasticated waistband, white drawstring with metal tips and a black CK logo on the lower left leg. Black side tapes printed with repeated CK Calvin Klein wordmarks run down both sides.

7745884394.alt_text: Navy Hermes tie with small teal, blue and pink horseshoe-like pattern, rolled at the end
7745884394.description: Navy Hermes tie shown partly rolled, with a pointed blade. The surface has a dense all-over pattern of small curved shapes in teal, blue and pink.

7745892294.alt_text: Black Comme des Garcons Play t-shirt with large upside-down red heart logo with eyes on the front
7745892294.description: Black short sleeve crew neck t-shirt with a large upside-down red heart and eyes print across the front. A white Play label is visible inside the neckline.

7745892300.alt_text: Blue Hermes tie with small white H motifs repeated across a fine ribbed weave, shown rolled
7745892300.description: A blue Hermes tie shown partly rolled, with a fine ribbed texture and a pointed tip. Small white H motifs are spaced evenly across the whole surface, and the title lists it as silk.

7745892366.alt_text: Grey Adidas shorts with black drawstring waist and small white performance logo on the left leg
7745892366.description: Grey Adidas shorts with an elastic waistband, black drawstring and side slits at the hem. A small white Adidas logo sits on the left leg with white text detail near the side seam.

7745894344.alt_text: Light blue Louis Vuitton tie with navy diagonal stripes and white monogram flower and LV motifs
7745894344.description: Light blue Louis Vuitton tie shown rolled, with thin navy diagonal stripes across a twill-textured surface. Small white LV initials and monogram flower motifs are spaced between the stripes.

7745894348.alt_text: White Corteiz t-shirt with black Supreme Rules The World Alcatraz graphic on the chest
7745894348.description: White short sleeve crew neck t-shirt with a large black front print reading Supreme Rules The World around an oval Alcatraz island emblem. A small yellow Corteiz label sits inside the neck.

7745896330.alt_text: Pink and white Hermes tie with diagonal stripes and small chain link motifs in red, orange and black
7745896330.description: Rolled Hermes tie in pink, white and grey diagonal stripes with rows of small chain link motifs in red, orange, black and cream. The listing title describes it as a silk tie.

7745898288.alt_text: Navy Stone Island denim overshirt with silver snap buttons, chest pockets and compass badge on left sleeve
7745898288.description: Navy denim overshirt with a point collar, silver snap button front and two chest pockets, one angled and one with a snap flap. A Stone Island compass badge sits on the left sleeve and the snap cuffs are buttoned.

7745912206.alt_text: Blue Louis Vuitton tie with all-over light blue LV monogram and flower motifs, shown rolled
7745912206.description: Blue Louis Vuitton tie with an all-over light blue monogram of LV initials, flowers and circle motifs. The tie is shown rolled, with a fine textured weave and pointed blade tip.

7745921003.alt_text: Navy Yeezy oversized hoodie with white dove print across the upper back, shown from behind on a model
7745921003.description: Navy oversized hoodie shown from the back on a model, with a large white dove print across the shoulders. It has a drawn-up hood, dropped shoulders and a gathered elastic hem.

7745926080.alt_text: Black Essentials t-shirt and shorts set with white Essentials Fear of God wordmarks on chest and leg
7745926080.description: Black Essentials set made up of a dropped-shoulder t-shirt with a small white Essentials Fear of God wordmark on the chest and matching shorts. The shorts have an elastic waist, long black drawstring, rubber logo patch and a white wordmark on the left leg.

7745928012.alt_text: Black faded Acne Studios wide leg jeans with paint splatter and studded back pockets, shown front and back
7745928012.description: Washed black denim jeans with grey fading on the thighs, small paint splatter marks and a button fly. The back has darker patch pockets edged with metal studs, and the legs are cut wide.

7745930036.alt_text: Navy Louis Vuitton tie with tonal checkerboard pattern and small white LV logo
7745930036.description: Navy tie shown rolled, with a tonal checkerboard pattern across the blade. A small white LV logo is embroidered near the centre of the front.

7745935962.alt_text: Black Nike beanie with white swoosh logo on the front, worn by a model in a black zip top
7745935962.description: Black Nike beanie shown on a model, with a smooth fitted shape and a small white swoosh logo at the front. The model also wears a black zip-up top with a tonal swoosh on the chest.

7745941914.alt_text: Grey Corteiz tracksuit with cream panels, large chest wordmark and Corteiz text on both trouser legs
7745941914.description: Grey Corteiz track jacket and matching trousers with cream curved panels, a full zip, stand collar and elasticated cuffs and hem. The chest carries a large Corteiz wordmark with crest badges, and the drawstring trousers show Corteiz text near each hem.

7745955788.alt_text: Grey Gucci tie with all-over brown and black G monogram pattern, shown rolled
7745955788.description: Grey tie with an all-over repeating G monogram in white outline over diagonal brown and black bands. The tie is shown rolled with its pointed blade end at the front.

7745955792.alt_text: Red and navy striped Gucci tie with white pinstripes, gold GG logos, bee motifs and 1921 embroidery
7745955792.description: Rolled tie in diagonal red and navy stripes edged with thin white lines and a ribbed texture. Embroidered details include a gold GG logo, gold bee motifs and white 1921 numerals.

7745961746.alt_text: Blue Gucci tie with all-over light blue GG monogram and small gold horsebit motifs
7745961746.description: Blue Gucci tie shown rolled, with an all-over light blue GG monogram on a darker blue woven ground. Small gold horsebit motifs are scattered across the pointed blade.

7746040722.alt_text: Black Supreme polo shirt with white outlined number 7 on the chest and white script logo opposite
7746040722.description: Black short sleeve polo shirt with a ribbed collar, two-button placket and red Supreme neck label. A white outlined number 7 sits on one side of the chest with a white script Supreme logo on the other.

7746153653.alt_text: Black Adidas wide leg track pants with grey camo print, white side stripes and white logos at the hips
7746153653.description: Black and grey camo track pants with white three-stripe tape down each side, an elasticated drawstring waist and toggle hems. A white ape head logo sits on the left hip and a white Adidas trefoil logo on the right hip.

7746436644.alt_text: Black polo shirt with green and red striped collar, green sleeve bands and small green chest emblem
7746436644.description: Black short sleeve polo shirt with a green and red striped collar, two-button placket and green bands on the sleeves. A small green emblem sits on the chest, and the collar label and hang tag read Gucci, not the listed brand Moncler.

7746481588.alt_text: Olive Salomon trousers with zip thigh pocket and dark printed Salomon logo outline on the left leg
7746481588.description: Olive Salomon trousers with a button waist, belt loops, slanted front pockets and a zip pocket on the left thigh. A dark printed Salomon wordmark and angular outline sit on the left leg, with articulated seams at the knees.

7746528290.alt_text: Grey Stone Island crewneck sweatshirt with black compass badge patch on the left sleeve
7746528290.description: Grey marl crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem. A black Stone Island compass badge sits on the upper left sleeve and a white brand label shows inside the neck.

7746587334.alt_text: Black Lacoste pullover hoodie with small green crocodile logo on the chest and front kangaroo pocket
7746587334.description: Black Lacoste pullover hoodie with a drawstring hood, green neck tape and a small green crocodile patch on the left chest. It has a front kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem.

7746627977.alt_text: Black Celine ribbed crew sock with white Triomphe emblem and white CELINE wordmark band
7746627977.description: Black ribbed crew sock with a white Triomphe emblem near the cuff. A white stripe band across the leg carries the CELINE wordmark in black.

7746669576.alt_text: Blue Lacoste puffer jacket with stand collar, full zip and small crocodile logo on the chest
7746669576.description: Blue Lacoste puffer jacket with horizontal quilted panels, a high stand collar and a full front zip. It has two side welt pockets, elasticated cuffs and a small crocodile logo on the left chest.

7746675044.alt_text: Black The North Face polo shirt with small white logo on the chest and two-button placket
7746675044.description: Black short sleeve polo shirt with a pointed collar, two-button placket and small white The North Face logo on the left chest. A white FlashDry wordmark sits near the lower hem and a logo label shows inside the collar.

7746855552.alt_text: Black Lacoste crewneck sweatshirt with small green crocodile patch on the chest
7746855552.description: Black crewneck sweatshirt with a small green Lacoste crocodile patch on the left chest. It has dropped shoulders and ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, and the listing title names the colour as navy.

7746864804.alt_text: White Stussy crewneck sweatshirt with blue script logo on chest and black seashell graphic print on back
7746864804.description: White crewneck sweatshirt shown front and back, with a blue Stussy script logo on the left chest and ribbed cuffs and hem. The back has a black and white seashell graphic with a blue Stussy logo and small text lines.

7746868294.alt_text: Beige Burberry low-top sneakers with check side panels, black heel tab and cream sole
7746868294.description: A pair of beige low-top Burberry sneakers with tonal laces and check fabric panels on the sides. They have a black heel tab, a small logo on the tongue and a cream rubber cupsole.

7746884024.alt_text: Grey Corteiz crewneck sweatshirt with black baseball player and Alcatraz graphic and Corteiz wordmark on front
7746884024.description: Heather grey Corteiz crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem. The front has a black print of a baseball player and the Alcatraz logo with Corteiz and Rules The World text, plus a small logo label inside the neck.

7746887412.alt_text: Grey Lacoste hoodie with navy wordmark on the chest and four green crocodile logos down the right sleeve
7746887412.description: Grey marl Lacoste pullover hoodie with a drawstring hood, navy LACOSTE wordmark on the chest and four green crocodile logos running down one sleeve. Ribbed cuffs and hem finish the piece.

7746891488.alt_text: White Balenciaga puffer jacket with stand collar and small chest logo, worn open over a black t-shirt
7746891488.description: White quilted puffer jacket with a high stand collar, full front zip and toggle drawcords at the hem. A small Balenciaga wordmark with red and navy wave stripes sits on the left chest.

7746892174.alt_text: White Moncler crewneck sweatshirt with large pixelated logo patch on the chest
7746892174.description: White crewneck sweatshirt with a large pixel-style Moncler bell logo in navy, blue and red across the chest. It has ribbed cuffs, a ribbed hem and a striped tape detail inside the collar.

7746894094.alt_text: Beige Lacoste long sleeve knit polo with green crocodile logo on the chest
7746894094.description: Beige long sleeve Lacoste polo in a fine knit with a pointed collar and three-button placket. A small green crocodile logo sits on the left chest, with ribbed cuffs and hem.

7746902202.alt_text: Black Burberry sweatpants with beige check side panels, drawstring waist and ribbed cuffs
7746902202.description: Black Burberry sweatpants with an elastic drawstring waist and ribbed ankle cuffs. Beige check panels run along the side pockets on both hips.

7746904810.alt_text: Grey Supreme crewneck sweatshirt with square photo print of a mouth with grillz and rolled cash on the front
7746904810.description: Grey crewneck sweatshirt shown front and back, with a square photographic print of a mouth holding a roll of cash on the chest. Ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, a small red Supreme tag at the neck and a plain back.

7746913124.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren crewneck sweatshirt with Polo Bear print holding a gift and Polo Bear by Ralph Lauren text
7746913124.description: Navy crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and hem and a Polo Ralph Lauren neck label. The front shows a Polo Bear in a festive jumper and jeans holding a wrapped gift, above Polo Bear by Ralph Lauren text and a signature.

7746914280.alt_text: Black Supreme crewneck sweatshirt with a photo print of a person in a white box logo tee on the chest
7746914280.description: Black crewneck sweatshirt shown front and back, with a rectangular photo print of a person wearing a white Supreme box logo t-shirt on the chest. It has ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, a plain back and a small red Supreme neck label.

7746941896.alt_text: Navy Prada tracksuit with white and black chest stripes, PRADA wordmark and triangle logo on jacket and pants
7746941896.description: Navy zip-up track jacket with a stand collar, white and black stripes across the chest and sleeves, a PRADA wordmark and triangle logo plaque. Matching navy pants with drawstring waist, white side stripes, ribbed cuffs and a triangle logo.

7746965908.alt_text: Black Carhartt leather-look work jacket with canvas panels and square logo patch on the chest
7746965908.description: Two black Carhartt work jackets on hangers, each with a glossy leather-look body, matte canvas panels on the sleeves and shoulders, a point collar and front button placket. Both have a small square logo patch on the chest and patch pockets at the front.

7746996952.alt_text: Black Celine t-shirt with large white gothic Celine wordmark on the chest, shown beside a white version
7746996952.description: Black short sleeve crew neck t-shirt with a large white gothic Celine wordmark across the chest and a Celine neck label. The photo also shows the same t-shirt in white with a black wordmark.

7747072802.alt_text: Black Louis Vuitton duffel bag with embossed monogram and wordmark shoulder strap
7747072802.description: Black Louis Vuitton duffel bag with an all-over embossed monogram, rolled top handles, a padlock at the zip and a hanging name tag. A detachable shoulder strap carries a repeated Louis Vuitton wordmark.

7747351535.alt_text: Black Chrome Hearts crewneck sweatshirt with blue and white scroll logo across the chest
7747351535.description: Black crewneck sweatshirt with dropped shoulders, ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem. A blue scroll banner with white gothic Chrome Hearts lettering sits across the chest.

7747559351.alt_text: Pink and red Bape camo shorts with large shark face print and ape head logo on the leg
7747559351.description: Pink and red camo shorts with a large black and white shark mouth and eyes print across the front. They have a ribbed pink elastic waistband and a brown ape head logo on the lower left leg.

7747674776.alt_text: Black Louis Vuitton Keepall duffel bag with grey monogram print and burgundy top handles
7747674776.description: Black Louis Vuitton Keepall duffel bag covered in an all-over grey LV monogram print, with two black vertical straps running down the front. It has burgundy rolled top handles on silver-tone hardware and a top zip with a tan leather pull.

7747694884.alt_text: Brown Louis Vuitton monogram backpack with front zip pocket and purple base with raised yellow LV letters
7747694884.description: Brown Louis Vuitton backpack in an all-over monogram print with a front zip pocket and black trim. The base has a purple panel with raised yellow LV lettering.

7748006896.alt_text: Black drawstring shorts with large tonal interlocking GG monogram print all over
7748006896.description: Black shorts with an elastic drawstring waist, side pockets and a large tonal interlocking GG monogram printed all over. The print does not match the listed brand The North Face.

7748094227.alt_text: Black Louis Vuitton monogram box-shaped crossbody bag with black chain and leather strap
7748094227.description: Black and grey Louis Vuitton monogram box-shaped messenger bag with a front zip pocket and black corner fittings. It has a chunky black chain with a small orange detail and a black leather shoulder strap.

7748151626.alt_text: Light blue Saint Laurent jeans with navy embroidered YSL logo on the back pocket
7748151626.description: Light wash blue denim jeans with a faded grey tint, shown folded from the back. A large navy embroidered YSL logo sits on the back pocket, with a black leather waistband patch and hang tags attached.

7748538800.alt_text: Black Supreme denim shorts with red box logo tab at the waistband and five-pocket design
7748538800.description: Black washed denim shorts with a five-pocket layout, button fly closure, belt loops and metal rivets. A small red Supreme logo label sits on the inside waistband, and the legs are long and loose, ending above the knee.

7748824072.alt_text: Black Corteiz sneakers with yellow Nike Air insole logo and yellow Alcatraz tongue badge, top view
7748824072.description: Top view of a pair of black Corteiz sneakers with diamond textured mesh panels, black laces and a grey centre strap. Yellow Alcatraz badges sit on the tongues and yellow Nike Air logos are printed on the insoles.

7749106776.alt_text: Blue Corteiz jeans shown from the back with stitched C logo and star on the rear pockets
7749106776.description: Mid-blue washed denim jeans shown from the back, with a stitched C logo on one rear pocket and a light star graphic on the other. A brown leather-look patch sits at the waistband and pintuck seams run down each straight leg.

7750223132.alt_text: Green camo Bape puffer vest with black zip, stand collar and ape head patch on the chest
7750223132.description: Green and black camo puffer vest from Bape with a quilted body, stand collar and full black zip. It has an ape head patch on the left chest, two side pockets and a small logo tab at the hem.

7750802710.alt_text: Black Louis Vuitton Keepall bag with grey monogram print, rolled handles and black webbing shoulder strap
7750802710.description: Black Louis Vuitton Keepall duffel bag with an all-over grey LV monogram, black rolled top handles and a matching name tag. It has silver-tone hardware and a detachable black webbing shoulder strap with a monogram flower motif.

7751506602.alt_text: Navy Stone Island overshirt with snap buttons, two chest pockets and compass badge on the left sleeve
7751506602.description: Navy Stone Island overshirt with a point collar, silver snap button front and two chest patch pockets, one with a snap flap. The left sleeve carries the black compass badge with buttons, and the cuffs are buttoned.

7751544750.alt_text: Cream t-shirt with pink script wordmark and three red cupid figures printed across the chest
7751544750.description: Cream short sleeve t-shirt with a ribbed crew neck and a yellow woven label inside the collar. The front shows a pink script wordmark surrounded by three red and white cupid figures holding bows.

7751578570.alt_text: Grey-blue Nike polo shirt with fine horizontal stripes and white logo on the chest
7751578570.description: Grey-blue short sleeve polo shirt with fine horizontal pinstripes, a solid grey collar and a three-button placket. A white Nike wordmark and swoosh logo sits on the left chest.

7751659649.alt_text: Grey Sp5der shorts with large white rhinestone-style curved wordmark across the front and speckled finish
7751659649.description: Grey Sp5der shorts with an elasticated waistband, side pockets and an all-over white speckled finish. A large curved white wordmark in a dotted rhinestone style sits across the front, with a brand tag attached at the waist.

7752149009.alt_text: Brown Broken Planet hoodie with white Satan Come When You Need text, red devil and yellow planet print
7752149009.description: Brown pullover hoodie with drawstring hood, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem. The front shows white Satan Come When You Need lettering above a red devil and a yellow ringed planet.

7752319463.alt_text: Black and grey camo Adidas track pants with white three stripes, ape head patch and trefoil logo
7752319463.description: Black track pants with an all-over grey camo print, white three stripes down the sides and an elastic drawstring waist. A white ape head patch sits on the left thigh and a white trefoil logo on the right hip, with toggle cuffs at the hems.

7752326167.alt_text: Black Prada baseball cap with silver triangle logo plaque on the front panel
7752326167.description: Black Prada baseball cap with a curved brim showing rows of stitching and a centre front seam. A silver-tone triangle plaque with the Prada Milano wordmark sits on the front, and the listing names the material as leather.

7752772695.alt_text: Grey Stussy zip gilet with white logo on the chest, two zip pockets and black and white drawcords
7752772695.description: Grey Stussy gilet with a full front zip, stand collar and small white script logo on the chest. It has two vertical zip pockets, black and white drawcord toggles, a dark lining and a drawcord hem.

7752776725.alt_text: Navy Stone Island zip hoodie with drawstring hood and compass badge on the left sleeve
7752776725.description: Navy Stone Island zip-up hoodie with a drawstring hood, full front zip and split kangaroo pocket. The left sleeve carries the compass badge patch, with ribbed cuffs and hem.

7752843345.alt_text: Red Supreme waist bag with small box logo patch on the front and orange webbing loops
7752843345.description: Red Supreme waist bag with a curved shape, top zip closure and a small red box logo patch centred on the front. Orange webbing loops sit on each side of the front panel, with a white tag attached at the bottom.

7752911045.alt_text: Black and grey The North Face knit sneaker with logo on the side and rubber toe cap
7752911045.description: Black knit low-top sneaker with grey tonal panels, black laces and a pull tab at the heel. The North Face logo appears on the side of the upper and on the black rubber toe cap, above a lugged black sole with a small yellow badge.

7752933408.alt_text: Black Chrome Hearts polo shirt with white horseshoe logo on the left chest
7752933408.description: Black short sleeve polo shirt with a pointed collar and a three-button placket. A white Chrome Hearts horseshoe logo with gothic lettering sits on the left chest.

7752943316.alt_text: Washed grey-green Oakley t-shirt with small ellipse logo on the chest and curved panel seams
7752943316.description: Washed grey-green Oakley t-shirt with a ribbed crew neck and a small ellipse logo in the centre of the chest. Curved panel seams run down the front from the shoulders to the hem, and the cut looks boxy.

7753227558.alt_text: Green Fyredwrld croc-embossed leather belt with silver western-style buckle, keeper and tip
7753227558.description: Green belt with a croc-embossed finish and contrast stitching along the edges, shown coiled. It has a polished silver western-style buckle, matching keeper and pointed tip with rope-edge detailing.

7753284567.alt_text: Blue Essentials wide leg denim pants with long grey drawstrings at the elastic waist
7753284567.description: Mid blue washed denim pants with an elastic drawstring waist and long grey cords, worn with a black tee. The legs are wide and straight, falling loosely over the shoes with fading along the thighs.

7753509249.alt_text: Black Adidas crewneck sweatshirt with white three stripes on the sleeves and Manchester United devil crest
7753509249.description: Black Adidas crewneck sweatshirt with white three stripes running down the sleeves, a white ribbed collar and white ribbed cuffs. A white trefoil logo and a Manchester United devil crest sit on the chest, with a black ribbed hem.

7753519145.alt_text: Cream Corteiz t-shirt with large green No Carry Last back print featuring the Alcatraz logo and an eagle
7753519145.description: Back view of a cream short sleeve Corteiz t-shirt with a large green boxed print reading No Carry Last. The print includes the oval Alcatraz island logo and an eagle graphic between the words.

7753520967.alt_text: Grey and white Mertra hooded jacket with pixel block pattern and small black logo on chest and back
7753520967.description: Grey and white hooded jacket with an all-over pixel block pattern, shown from front and back. It has a covered front placket with snap buttons, drawcord hood, mesh-lined hood, cuffed sleeves and a small black M logo on the chest and upper back.

7753524829.alt_text: Burgundy and white Supreme balaclava with banknote portrait print and large white Supreme wordmark on the top
7753524829.description: Burgundy and white balaclava with an all-over banknote style print featuring a portrait, seal and SUPREME text. A large white Supreme wordmark runs across the top and a red Supreme box logo tag hangs from the side.

7753524895.alt_text: White Nike balaclava hood with large black Swoosh logo on the side and attached Nike Hood tag
7753524895.description: White Nike balaclava shown flat with a large black Swoosh printed across the side panel and a seam running down the neck section. A Nike Hood swing tag is attached near the top.

7753558343.alt_text: Light blue Ami short sleeve button-down shirt with grey heart A logo on the chest
7753558343.description: Light blue short sleeve shirt with a button-down collar, full button placket and turned-up sleeve cuffs. A grey Ami heart A logo sits on the left chest and a curved hem finishes the shirt.

7753568107.alt_text: Lime yellow Corteiz t-shirt with large red face graphic, barbed wire mouth and Alcatraz logo on the forehead
7753568107.description: Lime yellow short sleeve crewneck t-shirt with a large red and white face print on the front, featuring barbed wire across the mouth and the Corteiz Alcatraz logo on the forehead. A small Corteiz label sits inside the neckline.

7753577935.alt_text: Cream and dark brown Louis Vuitton LV Trainer sneakers with gold LV logo on the tongue and gum sole
7753577935.description: Pair of cream low-top Louis Vuitton LV Trainer sneakers with dark brown leather toe caps, side panels and heel overlays. Details include a gold LV tongue logo, gold script signature on the side, white laces, flower motifs on the heel and a gum rubber outsole.

7753579841.alt_text: Black Ami t-shirt with green contrast trims and green embroidered heart A logo on the chest
7753579841.description: Black short sleeve crewneck t-shirt with green ringer trims at the collar, sleeve hems and bottom hem, plus green contrast seam lines. A green embroidered Ami heart logo sits on the left chest.

7753581879.alt_text: Black Palm Angels t-shirt and shorts set with pink dripping logo print at the collar and waistband
7753581879.description: Black Palm Angels set made up of a crew neck short sleeve t-shirt and drawstring shorts. Both pieces carry a pink dripping Palm Angels wordmark, at the neckline on the t-shirt and below the elastic waistband on the shorts.

7753597749.alt_text: Black Palm Angels crewneck sweatshirt with white gothic logo arched around the neckline
7753597749.description: Black crewneck sweatshirt with a large white gothic Palm Angels wordmark printed in an arc around the collar, with drip details. It has ribbed cuffs and hem and a brand label inside the neck.

7753996224.alt_text: Black Bape polo shirt with brown ape head patch on the chest and large white numbers on the sleeves
7753996224.description: Black short sleeve polo shirt with a two-button placket, ribbed collar and a brown textured ape head patch on the left chest. White numbers appear on both sleeves, with a small ape head emblem on the left sleeve cuff.

7754243355.alt_text: Brown Supreme shorts with large white Supreme wordmark across the back below the elastic waistband
7754243355.description: Dark brown Supreme shorts shown from the back with an elastic waistband and a yoke seam. A large white Supreme script wordmark is printed across the upper back.

7754356157.alt_text: Red Loro Piana baseball cap with tonal embroidered crest and script logo on the front panel
7754356157.description: Red Loro Piana six-panel baseball cap with a curved brim and a thin white trim along the brim edge. The front shows a tonal red embroidered crest above the Loro Piana script wordmark.

7754753561.alt_text: Black Ralph Lauren harrington style bomber jacket with small red pony logo on the chest
7754753561.description: Black Ralph Lauren bomber jacket with a stand collar, silver full-length zip and small red pony logo on the chest. It has two flap pockets with buttons and ribbed cuffs and hem, shown with a Union Jack swing tag attached.

7754916661.alt_text: Light blue Ralph Lauren polo shirt with small navy pony logo on the chest
7754916661.description: Light blue short sleeve polo shirt with a flat collar, two-button placket and ribbed sleeve cuffs. A small navy pony logo is embroidered on the left chest and a Polo Ralph Lauren label sits inside the neck.

7754985081.alt_text: White Lacoste polo shirt with small green crocodile logo on the chest and hang tags attached
7754985081.description: White short sleeve Lacoste polo shirt with a ribbed collar, two-button placket and ribbed sleeve cuffs. A small green crocodile logo sits on the left chest and hang tags are attached at the placket.

7755002797.alt_text: Navy Nike crewneck sweatshirt with small white swoosh logo on the chest
7755002797.description: Navy Nike crewneck sweatshirt shown on a hanger with a small white swoosh logo on the left chest. It has a ribbed collar, ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem, with a branded neck label.

7755024471.alt_text: Cream Yeezy Foam Runner slip-on shoe viewed from above with sculpted cut-out vents across the upper
7755024471.description: Cream Yeezy Foam Runner shown from a top-down view, with a one-piece moulded upper and organic cut-out vents along the toe and sides. A small embossed wordmark is visible on the textured footbed inside.

7755073809.alt_text: Grey The North Face ribbed knit beanie with black and white box logo patch on the folded cuff
7755073809.description: Grey ribbed knit beanie with a wide folded cuff. A black rectangular patch with the white The North Face logo sits on the front of the cuff.

7755266186.alt_text: Navy Moncler glossy puffer gilet with high collar, front zip and logo patch on the chest
7755266186.description: Navy glossy quilted puffer gilet from Moncler with a high stand collar, snap-fastened hood attachment and full front zip. It has two zip hand pockets, a felt logo patch on the chest and a triangle logo pull on the pocket zip.

7755303278.alt_text: Light blue Ralph Lauren faded jeans with brown leather back patch and small metal pony on the back pocket
7755303278.description: Folded light blue faded denim jeans shown from the back, with light distressing on the back pocket and a brown leather waistband patch printed with a pony and POLO. A small metal pony emblem sits on the edge of the right back pocket.

7755401981.alt_text: White Burberry shorts with black drawstring, beige check side panels and small equestrian knight logo on leg
7755401981.description: White Burberry shorts with an elasticated waistband and black drawstring cords. Beige check stripe panels run down the sides, with a small beige equestrian knight logo on the lower left leg.

7755483585.alt_text: White Palace t-shirt with small line drawing graphic and wordmark on the left chest, worn by a model
7755483585.description: White short sleeve Palace t-shirt with a crew neck and dropped shoulders, shown on a model. A small black line drawing graphic with a Palace wordmark sits on the left chest.

7755534119.alt_text: Black shorts with grey flame H graphics on both legs, white drawstring and round white logo on left leg
7755534119.description: Black washed shorts with an elastic waistband, white drawstring and side split hems. Large grey flame-style H graphics run down both legs, with a round white logo near the left hem.

7755555971.alt_text: White New Balance polo shirt with small black skateboarding character graphic and wordmark on the chest
7755555971.description: White short sleeve polo shirt with a ribbed collar, two-button placket and a navy logo label inside the neck. A small black line drawing of a character on a skateboard sits above a New Balance wordmark on the left chest.

7755785721.alt_text: Black and grey checkerboard backpack with top handle, silver zips and front zip pocket
7755785721.description: Black and grey checkerboard backpack with a domed shape, black top carry handle and double silver-tone zip pulls. A front zip pocket carries a small embossed emblem, though the design does not match the The North Face listing title.

7755788972.alt_text: Grey Nike sweatpants with small black boxed Swoosh and Stussy logo on the upper left leg
7755788972.description: Heather grey Nike joggers with an elasticated waistband, side pockets and ribbed ankle cuffs. A small black boxed Swoosh logo with Stussy wordmark sits on the upper left thigh.

7755813092.alt_text: Black Chrome Hearts high-top sneakers with multicoloured cross patches, white laces and cream rubber soles
7755813092.description: Black leather high-top sneakers covered in multicoloured cross patches in pink, silver, orange, teal, gold and more. They have white laces, metal eyelets, a cream toe cap and a cream sole with black stripes.

7755860257.alt_text: Light blue Burberry button-up shirt with tonal embroidered logo on the chest and check-lined collar
7755860257.description: Light blue long sleeve Burberry shirt with a pointed collar, white button front and buttoned cuffs. A tonal embroidered logo sits on the chest and the collar band shows a check lining, with a brown brand tag attached.

7755870993.alt_text: Sage green Hoka Kaha hiking boots with yellow laces, white midsole and Vibram gum outsole
7755870993.description: Pair of sage green Hoka Kaha hiking boots shown sole to sole, with suede uppers, embossed Hoka logo on the side and yellow speckled laces. Details include a Gore-Tex tag, thick white midsole and brown Vibram lugged outsole.

7755881398.alt_text: White Bottega Veneta t-shirt with black text reading When your own initials are enough on the lower left front
7755881398.description: White short sleeve Bottega Veneta t-shirt with a ribbed crew neck and a boxy cut. Black stacked text reading When your own initials are enough runs down the lower left front.

7755919815.alt_text: Olive bomber jacket with ribbed collar, centre zip and utility pocket on the sleeve
7755919815.description: Olive green bomber jacket with a ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, a silver-tone centre zip and a check-lined collar with a neck label. It has a chest patch pocket, side pockets and a zip utility pocket on the left sleeve.

7755946311.alt_text: Black Palm Angels crewneck sweatshirts with white and pink gothic logo around the neckline
7755946311.description: Two black crewneck sweatshirts shown side by side, one with a white and one with a pink gothic Palm Angels wordmark printed around the collar. Both have dropped shoulders and ribbed cuffs and hem.

7756320034.alt_text: Black Kith sneakers with mesh upper, small white Kith tab and sculpted cutout sole
7756320034.description: Pair of all-black Kith sneakers with a mesh upper, overlays, black laces and a pull tab at the heel. A small white Kith label sits on the side and the chunky sole has wave-shaped cutouts.

7756461584.alt_text: Black Amiri shirt and shorts set with large white AMIRI wordmarks, star and crest prints
7756461584.description: Black short sleeve shirt with camp collar and button front, paired with matching drawstring shorts. Both pieces carry large white AMIRI wordmarks, MA crest badges and outlined star prints.

7756473498.alt_text: Blue Corteiz mesh beanie with large white outlined script logo across the front
7756473498.description: Blue mesh beanie with a perforated finish and a folded cuff. A large white outlined Corteiz script wordmark with an underline swoosh runs across the front.

7756476488.alt_text: Black Supreme knit beanie with large white Supreme wordmark across the crown and folded cuff
7756476488.description: Black knit beanie with a large white Supreme wordmark knitted across the crown above a wide folded cuff. A red Supreme box logo tag and a Dover Street Market tag are attached at the top.
